name: Bash Command Safety
directive: Block dangerous Bash commands: force-push to main/master, catastrophic deletes, sudo, .env writes, curl/wget piped to shell
precision_note: 2026-08-01: synced to the main engine's operator-approved 2026-07-28 PRECISION pattern (~/.claude/enforcements/bash-safety.json), which this stale Apr-18 twin never received. NOT a weakening: root-elevation still blocks in COMMAND position, and force-push to main/master, rm -rf / or ~, real dotenv WRITES and curl|wget piped to an interpreter all still block unchanged. What stops blocking: the word appearing anywhere in unrelated text (it rejected a git commit whose MESSAGE merely mentioned it, and read-only greps), plus dotenv READS. Validated against 17 fixtures (10 must-block, 7 must-allow) before writing. Rollback: bash-safety.json.bak-2026-08-01
message: Dangerous Bash command blocked. Prohibited: force-push to main/master, rm -rf / or ~, sudo, writing to .env, curl|bash / wget|sh (remote code exec). Defense-in-depth alongside settings.json deny rules.
